name: Holdem Coach: Poker Trainer
description:
Build your poker skills, one decision at a time. Holdem Coach offers practical Texas Hold'em training for new players and experienced players refreshing their fundamentals.

• Short lessons, one idea at a time. Nothing is timed, so take as long as you like.

• Which hands to play: Nobody has bet yet. Decide whether your two cards are worth raising with.

• When someone raises: Another player has raised. Decide whether to fold, call, or raise again.

• Is it worth calling?: Work out the price you are being offered and whether your hand is worth it.

• Reading the cards: Look at your cards and the shared cards, and name the best hand you can make.

• Which hand is in front?: Two hands are shown. Choose the one more likely to win.

• Hand charts: See at a glance which two-card hands to play from each seat.

• Practise your mistakes

• Reads the cards, the question and the answer aloud, using your phone's voice.

Free to use, with ads. Practice works offline; ads require an internet connection. Spoken coaching uses your phone's available voices. This is a training app with no real-money wagering, not a poker solver or a promise of winnings.
